name: Timeline
structurePatterns: vertical list of events; every non-final current event owns the connector from its node toward the next event node
event spacing is part of the current event block so the connector remains continuous through variable content height and inter-event spacing
content to the right: optional timestamp caption, title (body), optional supporting text (body-small)
node stays aligned near the timestamp / first content line even when supporting text wraps
node color carries status only when the event actually has status meaning; text and chronology remain readable without color
the final event owns no outgoing connector and terminates the rail cleanly
Timeline does not require a Card container
usageHints: chronological order must be explicit (newest first or oldest first, labeled if needed)
group long histories by meaningful date or phase boundaries
timeline records event history; it does not replace a task Stepper
status is never conveyed by color alone (readable event text remains authoritative)
connector layout must follow real event height; do not derive rail length from a fixed number of text lines
doNotInvent: no oversized icons replacing the 10px node
no connector owned by the following event
